The Analytics Engine team has released new User Contribution Guidelines for the Cal-Adapt: Analytics Engine Notebooks on GitHub. These guidelines outline how community members can share their own notebooks and projects, ensuring consistency, usability, and alignment with existing Analytics Engine and _climakitae_ functionality. Explore the contribution requirements and learn how to submit your own work to the repository [here](https://github.com/cal-adapt/cae-notebooks?tab=contributing-ov-file).
